column1: # Format: address<TAB>name<TAB>type<TAB>comment<TAB>status   (status = confidence tag, see awto-dan docs/embedded/reversing/README.md)

column4: Front-panel key scan. Reads ADC_A0/A1 (0xFF09/0xFF0A) with 3-try settle loop, bands -> key mask in XDATA dbad (scratch), P3.0 low -> bit0. Returns debounced mask (2 identical scans, e205). See docs/reversing/realtek-rtd/buttons.md.
|prev - new| < 5 style compare of two ADC_A0 samples (via 0x002e abs helper); CY set = stable.
Same as 3ab6 for the ADC_A1 sample.
Key poll tick: skip if e207!=0; e208->e209 (prev), key_scan_adc -> e208, key_power_edge, else key_event_dispatch.
Switch on key mask e208: 02->idx0, 04->idx1, 08->idx2, 10->idx3, 18->idx3, 20->idx4 (only if e14e/e14f==0); calls key_post_event(R5=idx,R7=mask).
Writes key index to e151 (OSD key event); on key change checks long-press (641e); else auto-repeat via timer 1 (500 units).
Power key (P3.0 low, mask bit0) press edge (e208 vs e209): banked call 0x0f39(1|2) toggles power; CY=1 = handled.
For mask 0x10/0x18 arms timer id 0xd with 0x0BB8 (3000 units) = long press; returns CY=1.
Clears e152 bit4, cancels timers 0xb,0xd,0xe.
Sets e067 bits 0/1 and banked-calls 0x0dc5 when e208 == 0x03 (0x18/0x14 compares unreachable from 5942).
Called when ADC/pin read no key: copies 8 bytes from code 0xFF:3067 to dbb4, 57f3 check; returns dbbe. Role unknown (non-ADC key source?).
Returns CY=1 when key scan allowed (e152 bit1 handling, arms timer 2 = 10 units).
Key event index written by key_post_event (0..4); consumed by bank0 OSD handlers (cases 1,2,3,6 via DEC chain); 7/8 used as idle markers by key_poll.
Key scan flags: bit0/1 scan busy, bit2 repeat, bit3 held, bit4 longpress armed.
Last debounced key mask; same value twice = accepted.
Current key mask (bit0 P3.0 power, 1/2/4/8/0x10/0x20).
Previous key mask.
Toggles osd_en (0x3A02[0]) from bit03; on disable first clears 0x0094[7:5,3:2] (SRAM CS rule, docs/reversing/realtek-rtd/osd.md); on enable calls 0x0855(8) twice.
R7=0x94 write-option (bytesel[7:5], sram_sel[3:2]), R2:R3=word addr -> 0x0090/0x0091, data DC3F -> 0x0092. Single OSD byte write.
R5 -> 0x94 bytesel, R2:R3 -> 0x90/0x91, returns 0x0092 (read-back).
Loops writing 3-byte words (DBB7,DBB8,DBB9) to 0x0092 after osd addr setup with option 0xE0 (window SRAM); count in DBBA via helper 0x1312.
Writes font_base[14:0] (3A17[6:4], 3A0E, 3A0D[3:0]) from DBBB:DBBC; R4==0 also fs_base (3A0C, 3A0D[7:4]) + row_base0 3A19/3A1B/3A1C, R4==1 base1 set 3A1A/3A1D.
0x006E=0x80|R7 (lut_acc_en+index), R5/R3 then DBBA byte to 0x006F (COLOR_LUT_PORT), clears 0x006E.

R7*3 + 0x2FB3 -> DPTR, returns 16-bit offset R6:R7 from bytes 1..2 of the 3-byte (seg=0xFF,hi,lo) entry; 15 entries -> 9 distinct 197-B blobs at 0x28C6..0x2FB2 (flash 0x628C6..0x62FB2; ent~7.0 = VLC glyph-set candidate). Called only from 0x4e55.

Thunk 0x106b. Streams VLC-compressed glyph bitmaps from SPI flash into OSD font SRAM. Flash src addr formed as DC3C:R2:R1 where DC3C=DBB7=SFR 0xFFFF (PBANK current bank), R2:R1=caller far-ptr offset. DBB8:DBB9 = OSD-SRAM DEST word (not flash). Selects font-set variant (DBBC 1->0xC5 2->0x85 3->0x44). 0x42ff: osd_compression_en 0x3A17|=1 ON, then &=0xFC OFF -> stream is VLC. docs/boot-logo.md.

SPI-flash read by absolute 24-bit addr SCA_INF_BWR_ADRH:ADRM:ADRL (0xFFF6/7/8) = DC3C:R2(param2):R1(param1); page reg 0x9F=PAGE_SEL=DC3D; count 0xFFF9/A=R4:R5; ctrl 0xFFF3. Only flash reader on the font-download path. docs/boot-logo.md.
Sets OSD font-SRAM write target: FUN_CODE_66ab(0xE0, R6:R7=DBB8:DBB9) programs port 0x94 write-option + 0x90/0x91 addr. DBB8:DBB9 is the SRAM destination word, NOT a flash address. docs/boot-logo.md.
Programs OSD access port 0x94 (write-option bytesel/sram_sel from R5/R7) then 0x6883 sets addr port 0x90. Called by 6868.
0x3A0B (f_dl orient/rotation) = (0x3A0B & 0x3A) | DBBD. DBBD = font-set variant byte.
Loads R3:R2:R1 = DBB2:DBB3:DBB4 (the far-pointer seg:mid:low set by 0x4272 entry from caller R3:R2:R1).
Alt font-download site: LCALL ptr_table_lookup 0x661d to pick one of nine 197-B glyph-set blobs (bank6 0x628C6-0x62FB2) then stream. Parallel to the 4 composer sites.
